changes: Free game Start opens durable local questions immediately; zero-price entitlement registration is queued and retried in the background before server session submission.
Paid games retain explicit consent, authoritative price/ownership checks and purchase receipts. Zero-price jobs always submit expectedPrice=0; repricing blocks rather than charging.
Missing unfinished-round progress is prefetched on the rules page. Unknown previous answers are never replaced by a new or fabricated round.
Historical results do not mount confetti; live results retain their celebration.
Both comparison labels use equal 20-point rows. Result markers are 18 points, use 13-point symbols, green for correct and the existing red for incorrect.
